summary: Liberty Capital Corp filed an 8-K regarding a credit agreement amendment for GCI, LLC. The amendment adds: (1) a $155M delayed draw term A-1 loan maturing December 2031 or five years after funding, (2) a $25M revolving facility for letters of credit maturing March 2030, and (3) a $300M term A-2 loan maturing June 2031. The loans are conditionally tied to the Quintillion Acquisition by GCI Holdings, but the filing is primarily a financing arrangement update rather than a standalone special situation. Interest rates are based on alternate base or SOFR plus margins of 1.00%-1.75% depending on leverage. This is a routine debt financing amendment.
